posts.name: cajunjoel
posts.cooked:
Yes, this is an unfortunate side effect of the migration of the posts. They all look "unread" to everyone. 

To mark all posts as read: Use the "Forum Tools" drop-down at the bottom of each of the topic list pages (e.g. http://sentinelsofthemultiverse.com/forums/general-discussion). Choose "Mark all topics Read". So if you want to mark EVERYTHING as read, then you'd need to do this at most about a dozen times. 

Looks like the pagination is a bit ugly, but at least its wrapping properly now.

I've adjusted the fonts a bit, so at least the list pages look a bit better. And, for some reason, the icons on the forum list page looked nothing at all like those on the topics list page. So I added new ones. 

*UPDATE* Oh! You can hit that same drop-down on the list of all forums, too. That's convenient. :) Look for the drop-down at the bottom of: http://sentinelsofthemultiverse.com/forum

Regarding the BBcode vs. Filtered text formats… Filtered gets you the WYSIWYG editor and more of a view of how your post will look. Personally, that’s pretty much all I use. 

The smileys, yes, I know. You do get attached to them  . Whether they appear or not is up for discussion. I’ll keep looking around.

–Joel

UPDATE: Aug 19 2012  You can now use BBCode in the “Filtered Text” inside the WYSIWYG editor. There should be no need to switch.
